intent: Add workspace-local agent handoff and polling so independently started Codex and Antigravity sessions can share a governed task ledger, transfer active responsibility, and escalate to the operator without broadening authority.
invariants: Workspace ledger is authoritative; Console observes and routes but cannot grant authority
Atomic claim or transfer prevents two active owners and preserves lease recovery
Delegation cannot increase requester authority; consequential action still uses approval and action contracts
Polling never reads sibling workspace ledgers or unregistered agents
proposed_entities_and_relationships: Entigram_Agent_Task: one workspace-scoped unit of work with one active owner
Entigram_Agent_Task_Event: immutable handoff, claim, progress, and escalation history
Entigram_Agent: registered participant with session-specific presence
uncertainty_unknowns: Whether active sessions can be woken automatically by their host, versus collecting work on lifecycle hooks or next poll
Whether session presence requires a new schema entity or can be represented by existing task events and leases
